title: EndGit
tagline: The modern web platform for EndStone — Minecraft Bedrock server management and plugin ecosystem.
overview: EndGit is the web platform for the EndStone ecosystem — a modern Minecraft Bedrock server framework. It provides a hub for plugin discovery, server management tools, and community resources for Bedrock server operators and plugin developers.
problem: The Minecraft Bedrock server ecosystem lacks a centralized, modern platform for discovering plugins, managing servers, and connecting with the developer community.
solution: EndGit provides a polished web experience built with TypeScript that serves as the central hub for the EndStone community — making it easy to find plugins, share resources, and manage Bedrock servers.
highlights: Modern web platform for EndStone ecosystem
Built for Minecraft Bedrock server operators
